contexts.text: Those with whom evils have predominated... are carried into the intestines, even to the last of them, namely, to the colon and rectum...
When those who constitute the colon intestine infest those who are in the province of the peritoneum...
Wherefore they who are in the colon and rectum are near the Hells which are called excrementitious.
The colon is of wide extent, and so are those who are in that province. Described.
Such are they who are in the Hell of the colon and rectum.
(The better sort of the Spirits of the colon and rectum, described.)
(The Spirits of the colon described.) SE 993. SE 1062. SE 1066.
